result: For the continuously uniform independent generator and shift, the expected normalized anchored fourth discrepancy in dimension one is 19/1620 for three lattice points and 4/405 for independent points. The excess is 1/540 and the ratio is 19/16. Counts one and two have the independent ensemble law in all dimensions. The two disjoint no-wrap triangles give a lower bound 2/[105(n-1)] that exceeds the independent-point moment for every n>=4 in dimension one. The second moments agree in all dimensions.
supplement: For x<=1/2, let U,V be the first two independent points, so the remaining raw coordinates are 2V-U and 3V-2U modulo one. For a skipped triple (0,1,3), the strip 0<=3V-2U<x has area x^2/3. The two reflected wrap triangles each have area (3x-1)_+^2/12. For all four points, the first three force 0<=2V-U<x. Then 3V-2U lies strictly between -x and 2x, ruling out wraps landing in [0,x). Endpoints t0 and raw t3 in that interval imply both interpolated points are in it and yield area x^2/3. Two consecutive triples have q=x^2/2. The independent factorial-moment derivation gives lower-half integrand 3x^4/2-11x^3/8+11x^2/32+x/64 + (3-8x)(3x-1)_+^2/64. Twice the integral is 2(1/240-1/6912)=139/17280; its independent-point excess is 1/432.
